svg.title: Marko’s Sydney attractions map
svg.desc: Sixteen Sydney attractions and shopping districts with approximate walking times from Marko’s at 38 College Street. Includes the new Sydney Fish Market at 1 Bridge Road, Glebe. Schematic map, not to scale. Use live directions when planning your visit.
svg.text: A meal in Darlinghurst. A city full of possibilities.
All times start at Marko’s, not at the previous stop.
Approximate one-way walks checked with Google Maps, 29 October 2026. Allow extra time for groups, crossings and photo stops.
Harbour Bridge time is to the southern Bridge Stairs on Cumberland Street; crossing the bridge takes additional time.
Original schematic map · positions and streets simplified, not to scale · use live directions for your walk
